description: This file defines the VocabularyForm class for managing vocabulary entities in Drupal, including form building, saving, and existence checks.

classes.name: Drupal\taxonomy\VocabularyForm
classes.description: Form class for creating and editing vocabularies in Drupal taxonomy module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the vocabulary storage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with the entity storage.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Builds the vocabulary entity, ensuring description is not an empty string.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the vocabulary form with fields for name, description, revision, language, and hierarchy.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the vocabulary entity, handles revision, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a vocabulary with the given ID already exists.
